global.title: SpaceX launches 21 Northrop Grumman satellites for U.S. military data network
global.summary: WASHINGTON — A SpaceX Falcon 9 launched 21 Northrop Grumman-built satellites for the U.S. military early Oct. 10, adding a third spacecraft manufacturer to the Pentagon’s communications network in low Earth orbit.
